offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance for businesses, farms, public entities and some individual customers. Its insurance subsidiaries distribute coverage through independent agents, brokers and program partners and handle claims under the policies they issue.

primary_products.value: specialty commercial liability and workers’ compensation insurance; commercial property and transportation insurance; crop insurance; surety bonds; fidelity and crime insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Businesses, farms, nonprofits and other private institutions; B2C: Individual horse owners and other specialty policyholders; B2G: Local governments and other public entities

end_markets.value: commercial and industrial businesses; transportation and logistics; agriculture; construction; public and nonprofit services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Premiums for specialty insurance coverage and surety bonds; service fees: Administration of workers’ compensation insurance programs

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Assumes and pools policyholder risks, providing coverage to businesses, public entities and individuals; service provider: Administers workers’ compensation insurance programs for affiliated and third-party insurers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with specialty insurance operations in Canada and Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Specialty casualty, property, transportation, crop, surety and fidelity insurance

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent retail agents, wholesale brokers and specialty insurance brokers; partners / resellers: Managing general agents and insurance program administrators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments oversee licensing, solvency, rates and forms, and federal rules govern federally backed crop insurance.

notes: The current scope of third-party program administration is uncertain.
divestiture_lines: P2.9: Sale of Commercial Lines Division
P2.15: Sale of long-term care business
P2.21: Sale of Annuity Business to MassMutual
